skill_name: Analyze the effect of computer vision on healthcare.
workflow: Computer vision has been revolutionizing the healthcare industry. It is being used for automating tedious and complex medical processes, helping doctors diagnose diseases faster and more accurately, and enabling better decision making through predictive analytics and imaging. Computer vision also assists in surgical operations by providing valuable insights, helping doctors identify and address potential issues quickly, and providing detailed real-time visual information.
